newsitem.title: USA: Viacom aims to reduce debt 20 to 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: Viacom aims to reduce debt 20 to 40 pct.

text.p: Viacom Inc Chairman Sumner Redstone Tuesday said debt reduction is a key part of the company's business strategy and it aims to cut total debt by 20 to 40 percent over the next 24 to 36 months.
Speaking at the Cruttenden Roth growth stock conference here, Redstone said the company's debt reduction plan will be significantly advanced by the sale of the company's radio assets.
Earlier, Evergreen Media Corp said it would buy 10 radio properties from Viacom for $1.08 billion in cash as part of a deal to acquire Chancellor Broadcasting Co..
Redstone said the company's debt is currently about five times cash flow, but that it had been as high as 11 times cash flow in 1987 after it completed its leveraged buyout.
